meta.title: ds-superbot
meta.description: A work-item console for DeepSeek Harness. The work item is the only product object; group chat is the only human/AI console; four presence faces — cang / tan / zuo / yan — cover sense, explore, build and verify. Decisions stay with humans, operations with AI, judgment with programs. Quiet decision cards in group chat handle items that need your decision; the session Workbench tab and the right Workbench show pending decisions, evidence, presence and history; process status stays out of chat. The 0.1.0 seven-role dispatch path (superbot_dispatch) remains as a compatibility implementation, not the product cover. Default authority is observe; auto-merge stays off.
